title: Among the Ruins
description: Ahmad Abou Adbou stands in front of Roman ruins in Apamea, Syria. He has worked as a shepherd in the nearby village of Al Karkat since he was young. "What drew me to Ahmad in particular was the fact that he embodies the continuity of everyday life within this historical landscape," photographer Charles Cuau tells National Geographic.
translated_description: 艾哈迈德·阿布·阿杜站在叙利亚阿帕米亚的罗马遗址前。他自幼便在附近的阿尔卡尔卡特村以牧羊为生。摄影师查尔斯·库奥告诉《国家地理》："艾哈迈德特别吸引我的地方在于，他体现了在这片历史景观中日常生活的延续性。"
